title: THE TOWER II · FIVE FLOORS + THE BASEMENT
vibe: green · hard on purpose · ~70 minutes · you asked for the Tower and you asked for abs, so the abs are built into the Tower
why: Ten hours of sleep, nothing sore, the whole day open, and you asked for hard with the Tower and the midline in front. That is a specific request and it gets a specific answer. The Tower is the highest rated session in this log and the shape you asked to see again, so the ARC comes back exactly as you liked it: one long descending list, one clock, worked straight through, no stations and no rest intervals, big horizontal pull and pressing volume, finished by finishing the list. What changes is everything inside it. Every movement is new against the 20th, the floors are five instead of six, and the abs are not a finisher this time. There is an ABS RUNG on every single floor, so the midline is loaded five separate times before you ever get to the dedicated core block. Written volume is roughly two hundred and seventy reps against the one hundred forty two written on the 20th. That is deliberate. You ran that list three times through and reported it as fine, so the number went up. Legs did mile repeats and loaded front squats yesterday, so nothing today squats, hinges heavy, or asks the legs for speed. The run is the longest continuous piece of the Singapore block, five kilometres at your own easy pace, because time on feet is the thing your aerobic file is actually missing, not a slower number.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · DAY A · SHOULDERS, SPINE, WRISTS
blocks.meta: ~8 min · Moves Method Day A · matched to an upper-body day · ONE PASS

items.name: PASSIVE HANG or OVERHEAD SQUAT REACH-OUT · 60 sec
items.detail: If there is a bar in the gym, hang and let the shoulders decompress for a full minute. If there is not, sit in a deep squat, press both palms overhead and reach long, alternating a slow side bend each way. You are about to press and row for twenty two minutes. Open the shoulders first.

items.name: SHOULDER DISLOCATES · 2 × 15
items.detail: Towel or band, hands wide, sweep from front to back and return. Slow. Narrow the grip a couple of inches on the second set if the first felt easy.

items.name: JEFFERSON CURL · 8 slow reps
items.detail: Empty hands or the 12 kg. Roll down one vertebra at a time, hang at the bottom for a breath, then stack back up from the bottom. This is the low back insurance and it is the reason the stiffness stopped showing up in your check-ins.

items.name: THORACIC ROTATIONS · 10 per side
items.detail: Side-lying windmill or quadruped thread-the-needle. Full rotation, eyes follow the hand. The cross-body row and the teaser both want this.

items.name: WRIST ROCKS + HALOS · 90 sec
items.detail: Palms down then palms up on the floor, rocking gently through the wrists for thirty seconds. Then ten halos each direction with the 12 kg. Wrists carry the rack position for two hundred and seventy reps today.

blocks.text: Day A off the Moves Method menu, which is the shoulders and spine day and the correct match for a pull and press session. Different from the last two days on purpose.

blocks.title: BLOCK 1 · THE TOWER II · FIVE FLOORS, DESCENDING, FOR TIME
blocks.meta: ~22 min · 5 FLOORS · ~270 written reps · ONE CLOCK, START IT AND DO NOT STOP IT · 2×22 kg DB pair · 20 kg KB · 2×16 kg
blocks.format: chipper · one descending list worked straight through · no stations, no prescribed rest, finish the list
blocks.workRest: Rest only when you have to and only long enough to pick the weight back up. The clock never stops. Rung order inside a floor is fixed. Finish a floor completely before you climb to the next one.

items.name: HOW THE TOWER IS BUILT
items.detail: Five floors. The floor number sets the rep count for that whole floor: FLOOR 1 = 20, FLOOR 2 = 16, FLOOR 3 = 12, FLOOR 4 = 8, FLOOR 5 = 4. Every floor has the same five rungs in the same order. The PRESS runs at HALF the floor number because it is the heaviest rung. The last rung on every floor is an ABS RUNG and it changes every floor. Read the five rungs once now so you are not reading mid-chipper.

items.name: RUNG 1 · DOUBLE DEAD-START CLEAN · 2×22 kg
items.detail: 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4. Both dumbbells go back to the floor and come to a dead stop between every rep. No bouncing, no touch-and-go. Hinge, snap the hips, catch clean in the rack. Sixty total reps across the Tower. This is the pull engine of the day and it is why the legs stay out of everything else.

items.name: RUNG 2 · DOUBLE STRICT PRESS · 2×22 kg · HALF THE FLOOR
items.detail: 10 / 8 / 6 / 4 / 2. Strict. No leg drive, no dip. Straight out of the rack position you just cleaned into, which is the whole point of the order. Thirty total across the Tower at the heaviest double-implement load in your log. If floor 1 or 2 grinds to a stop, finish the set with the 2×16 kg and go back up to the 22s on the next floor. Do not skip reps.

items.name: RUNG 3 · SINGLE-ARM CROSS-BODY ROW · 22 kg DB · ALTERNATING
items.detail: 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4, alternating hands, so half the count each side. Split stance, free hand on a bench or your knee, and row the dumbbell across your body toward the opposite hip rather than straight back. That diagonal path is the difference from the rows on the 20th and it hits the lat where the plain row does not. Sixty total.

items.name: RUNG 4 · UPRIGHT ROW · 2×16 kg
items.detail: 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4. Dumbbells in front, pull the elbows high and wide until the hands reach mid-chest, then control them down. Light on purpose. Sixty total. This rung is the upper back and rear delt volume that the Tower on the 20th never touched.

items.name: RUNG 5 · THE ABS RUNG · CHANGES EVERY FLOOR
items.detail: FLOOR 1 · 20 HOLLOW ROCKS — low back pinned to the floor, rock from the shoulders, do not break the shape. FLOOR 2 · 16 OVERHEAD DEAD BUGS holding the 16 kg locked out over your chest, alternating, count each limb pair as one. FLOOR 3 · 12 PILATES TEASERS — WILDCARD, first appearance in this program: lie flat, arms overhead, then roll up and lift the legs at the same time into a V, balanced on the tailbone, and roll back down one vertebra at a time under control. Slow is harder than fast here. FLOOR 4 · 8 V-UPS, hands and feet meeting over the middle. FLOOR 5 · 4 TURKISH GET-UPS at 20 kg, two per side, and they are the capstone of the whole Tower. Sixty total abs reps inside the Tower before the dedicated core block has even started.

blocks.noteGreen: The written number is two hundred and seventy and it was written at the top of the range on purpose. If you top out the list and the clock says you have more in you, the correct move is a second climb of FLOORS 3, 4 and 5 only, not a full second Tower, because the get-ups are the limiter and eight of them is plenty. Tell me which way it went and the next Tower gets built off that answer.
blocks.text: Seeded from Neupert #66 G&B 3 (double press paired with double clean) and #11 The Giant (clean and press ladder), rebuilt as a five-floor descending chipper, with the cross-body row, the upright row and the abs rungs pulled from the muscle-building split W_D4. Nothing here appeared on the 20th.

blocks.title: BLOCK 2 · THE LONG ONE · 5 KM CONTINUOUS
blocks.meta: ~24 min · 5 KM UNBROKEN · 12.5 to 12.9 km/h · the longest single run of the Singapore block
blocks.format: steady continuous aerobic at YOUR easy pace · one belt speed, one distance, no intervals
blocks.workRest: 5 km straight through. No walk breaks, no speed changes. Then 2 min walk at 5.5 km/h before the basement.

items.name: 5 KM @ 12.5 to 12.9 km/h
items.detail: Set the belt at 12.7 and leave it there. That is your own easy band, roughly a 7:40 mile, and it is not a corrective pace and not a restraint exercise. The variable today is DISTANCE, not speed. Your file says you are a comfortable three to four mile runner who has been choosing two miles for time reasons, and today you have the whole day, so this is five kilometres unbroken. Expect somewhere around twenty three and a half minutes.

items.name: CADENCE CUE · 168 TO 172
items.detail: Quick and short rather than long and reaching. It costs you nothing in pace and it takes real load off the calves and knees over twenty four minutes at two hundred fifty pounds. Count your right foot for fifteen seconds a few times through and you want forty two to forty three.

items.name: REPORT BACK
items.detail: Belt distance readout at the end and how the last kilometre felt compared to the first. This treadmill still is not calibrated and the readout is the only data we have on it.

blocks.text: Run style rotated off yesterday's mile repeats and off the incline ladders of the 19th and the 2nd. This is the duration piece, which is the one genuine hole in the running file.

blocks.title: BLOCK 3 · THE BASEMENT · DEDICATED MIDLINE
blocks.meta: ~12 min · 3 ROUNDS · 22 kg DB · 16 kg KB · rest 45 sec between rounds
blocks.format: circuit · anti-extension, anti-rotation and anti-lateral-flexion, one of each, plus endurance holds
blocks.workRest: Move rung to rung inside a round, 45 sec rest between rounds. 3 ROUNDS.

items.name: McGILL CURL-UP · 5 HOLDS OF 8 SEC PER SIDE
items.detail: One knee bent, one leg straight, hands under the small of your back to keep the lumbar arch, lift only the head and shoulders an inch off the floor and hold eight seconds. Five holds, then switch which leg is bent. This is an endurance exercise, not a rep exercise, and the arch under your hands is the whole point.

items.name: SIDE PLANK WITH TOP-LEG RAISE · 40 SEC PER SIDE
items.detail: Forearm side plank, hips stacked and high, then lift and lower the top leg slowly the whole time. Anti-lateral-flexion plus glute medius. Do not let the hip sag between reps.

items.name: BIRD DOG · 10 PER SIDE, SLOW
items.detail: Opposite arm and leg, reach long rather than high, pause a beat at full extension, and do not let the hips rotate. If a glass of water on your low back would spill, you are rotating.

items.name: SUITCASE LATERAL WALK · 22 kg · 15 m PER SIDE
items.detail: One dumbbell in one hand, walk SIDEWAYS fifteen metres, then back the other direction with the same hand loaded, then switch hands. Sideways is the variation you have not done. Stand tall, do not let the loaded side collapse, and do not lean away to counterbalance.

items.name: OFFSET OVERHEAD HOLD MARCH · 16 kg · 30 SEC PER SIDE
items.detail: One bell locked out overhead, elbow straight, march in place with a high knee. The overhead load forces the whole trunk to resist a side bend it desperately wants to make. Last rung of the day.

blocks.text: The core work today is deliberately doubled: sixty reps inside the Tower plus this block. Research lens is core and Pilates and anti-rotation, which had not been used since 20 July, and it seeded the McGill endurance holds, the dead bug progression and the teaser.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 5 MIN

items.name: WALK · 3 min @ 5 km/h
items.detail: Let the heart rate come down on its feet rather than sitting down.

items.name: CHILD'S POSE WITH SIDE REACH · 45 sec per side
items.detail: Reach both hands over to one side and breathe into the opposite ribs. Everything you did today shortened the front of the shoulders.

items.name: DOORWAY OR FLOOR CHEST OPENER · 45 sec per side
items.detail: Arm at ninety degrees against a frame, turn away slowly. Two hundred seventy reps of pulling and pressing earned this.

items.name: SUPINE TWIST · 45 sec per side
items.detail: Knees over to one side, opposite shoulder stays down, breathe. The teasers and the twisting rows will thank you tomorrow.

blocks.text: Short and honest. Do not skip it on a two hundred seventy rep upper day.
